event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'The FSFE Italian Community in Action' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Marta Andreoli will present an overview of the Italian Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE) community, focusing on what has been achieved so far in promoting Free Software and digital sovereignty at the local level.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Auditorium (A2).
